title: Independent Statistical and Leakage Audit of EXP-015
summary: All reported numerical results, cross-validation boundaries, leakage controls, and statistical hypothesis tests in EXP-015 were verified to full floating-point precision from the raw per-tile OOF data. Input sensitivity and the hybrid estimator demonstrate a massive, statistically significant out-of-fold advantage over the Sobel gradient baseline (p < 10^-10). A crucial nuance is that the hybrid's advantage is overwhelmingly driven by input sensitivity (alpha=0.19), with hybrid outperforming input sensitivity alone by a modest delta of +0.00665 (Wilcoxon p = 0.0042).

checks.description: Verify exactly 107 development tiles evaluated without missing, duplicate, or non-finite values.
checks.details: Total rows=107, unique tiles=107, non-finite values=0.

checks.description: Verify zero overlap with locked holdout (107 tiles) and quarantined set (42 tiles).
Verify exact numerical agreement between summary JSON and raw CSV derivations for all methods.
checks.details: All means, standard deviations, confidence intervals, and medians match to full precision (<1e-5 absolute diff).

checks.description: Verify paired hypothesis tests (Student's t, Wilcoxon signed-rank) for all method pairs.
checks.details: Hybrid vs Sobel t=6.3481 (p=5.52e-09), Wilcoxon W=507.0 (p=1.33e-13). Verified exactly.

checks.description: Verify that reported relative gain percentages use explicit, scientifically valid denominators.
checks.details: Hybrid vs Sobel relative gain is +37.0% using mean(Sobel)=0.222005 as denominator: (0.304210 - 0.222005)/0.222005 = +37.03%.

checks.description: Verify that spatial clusters (Chebyshev distance <= 10 tiles, ~3.3km) are never split across folds.
checks.details: All 4 multi-tile clusters in the dev set are 100% contained within individual folds. Cross-fold pairs <= 10 tiles = 0.

checks.description: Verify standardization and weight selection (alpha) depend strictly on training folds.
checks.details: Verified in run_exp015_cv.py: mu and std computed across train_tiles only; alpha tuned on train_tiles only; validation fold strictly out-of-fold.

checks.description: Audit whether the hybrid adds value beyond Input Sensitivity alone.
checks.details: Input sensitivity alone achieves mean rho=0.297557 (+34.0% over Sobel). Hybrid achieves rho=0.304210 (+37.0% over Sobel). Hybrid vs Input delta is +0.006653 (paired t p=0.0039, Wilcoxon p=0.0042). Hybrid wins on 62/107 tiles (57.9%).

checks.description: Verify mathematical distinction between AUSE and AURG and validation on synthetic unit tests.
checks.details: All 5 synthetic unit tests in metric_unit_tests.txt passed. Mathematical definitions strictly documented.

checks.description: Verify that no claims of calibration, geodetic accuracy, or building-level accuracy are made.
checks.details: EXP-015 explicitly caveats that results represent uncalibrated error-ranking heuristics and building evaluation is impossible locally.
